in_sanskrit.name: Suthar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Suthar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Suthar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means 'Sun'. This name is for a boy and is used to represent the Sun God in Hinduism. The name is believed to bring wisdom, power, and light into the life of the child.
